questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne opleve en del af Australien, som man ikke nødvendigvis hører så meget om. Det har bestemt ikke skuffet!

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var relativt nemt. Universitetet havde en administrator tilsluttet, som var behjælpelig med alle spørgsmål og kunne bidrage til indskrivning på fag, som ellers kan være en omstændig proces.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var både information om universitetet, byen og lokalområdet. Alt dette blev præsenteret gennem et introforløb den første uge.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte at gå med noget student accommodation. Der er mange udbydere i byen, men jeg kan på det varmeste anbefale Yugo.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Mange fandt billige huse at bo i uden for CBD, men jeg foretrak at forholde mig lokalt, hvilket jeg aldrig fortrød. Det kan forekomme lidt mere dyrt, men er rart, da man er tæt på det hele.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Igen vil jeg på det varmeste anbefale Yugo. Der er mange internationale og under mit ophold, var det her alle unge udvekslingsstuderende mødtes og nød en drink i weekenden.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Processen med at vælge fag kan være omstændig og det kan klart betale sig at sætte en del tid af til at undersøge alt fra det faglige niveau for det enkelte fag, til eksamensformen.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der var en ansat, som man kunne stille spørgsmål, men grundet tidsforskel kan det forlænge processen og gøre det mere uoverskueligt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg var heldig at få alle de fag jeg gerne ville have på forhånd. Selv et af fagene som fremgik som værende fyldt. Her kan det betale sig at kontakte studehjælpen, da de givetvis kan få udvekslingsstuderende ind på ellers fyldte hold.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tjek eksamensformen og vælg fag, hvor der alene skal afleveres assignments. Deres eksamener er typisk skriftlige (i hånden) og noter skal printes ud. Jeg brugte en del af min oplæsningstid på alene af dygtiggøre mig i håndskrift, da det ikke er noget jeg har gjort i mange år.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Pensum ligger online, hvilket fjerner en ekstra udgift.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det faglige niveau er generelt lavere end på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget det samme, men seminarerne er betydeligt lettere her og meget overfladiske. Typisk varer et seminar kun 1 time, hvilket kan besværliggøre at gå i dybden med det faglige stof.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Sports Law, Family Law, Environmental Law og Corporate Law,

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Sports Law og Environmental Law er begge meget anbefalelsesværdige. 
Corporate Law er efter min mening ikke egnet til udvekslingsstuderende. Pensum er stort og eksamensformen er skriftlig, hvor der forventes en del.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Visum er blevet meget dyrt.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Kød er billigt, modsat alle andre fødevarer. Generelt er alkohol heller ikke billigt her, hvis man har den slags tilbøjeligheder.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vi var et par udvekslingsstuderende, som meldte os ind i universitetets fodboldklub, hvor vi trænede med og spillede kampe under hele semesteret. Det var en super god måde at møde de lokale på.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Universitetet tilbyder en lang række sportsklubber, som man kan melde sig ind i. Der er over 120 klubber og derfor garanti for noget for enhver smag.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Der er mange nationalparker i området, som kan anbefales, herunder Morialta og Mt Lofty. Derudover vil jeg anbefale dagsture langs kysten.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Den australske humor minder meget om den danske og de lokale er nemme at falde i snak med.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Meld dig ind i en af universitetets klubber.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Alt lukker meget tidligt her.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Den australske venlighed.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Lær de andre internationale at kende, meld dig ind i en af universitetets klubber og undgå de skriftlige eksamener i hånden.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville personligt fraråde faget Corporate Law og Evidence and Advocacy - på trods af jeg ikke selv havde sidstnævnte er det et de lokale frygter meget under jurauddannelsen.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Mine oplevelser på fodboldholdet vil klart fremstå som de mest mindeværdige øjeblikke under mit ophold.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At finde balance mellem at ville opleve så meget som muligt, men også sørge for at holde sig ajour med det faglige.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
